notes.title: We're back
notes.notes:
[i]"Harland gave me pencils and paper so I can draw but I wanted to write instead. I see the Forest through our window and our high fence. Harland says I cannot go outside today. It is because I fell asleep yesterday on snow. And when I woke I was older.
I grow fast. Everything else not.
And it does not make life happy."[/i]
[previewyoutube=rjXX62xXgLM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release for Windows! (First Episode: Spring)
notes.notes:
We are sorry, but we will have to postpone the release for Linux.
Please note that it will be a one-time purchase. That is, when the next two episodes are released, you won't have to buy them again.
